overall_comment: Imaging strongly suggests an IDH-wildtype, non‑codeleted high‑grade glioma, but the very low necrosis and moderate enhancement introduce some uncertainty. Advanced sequences (perfusion, diffusion, spectroscopy) would be valuable to refine molecular prediction and grade assessment.
